libphonenumber-js 1.13.15, max metadata, MIT license.
Source: https://github.com/catamphetamine/libphonenumber-js
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/libphonenumber-js/-/libphonenumber-js-1.13.15.tgz
The official bundle/libphonenumber-max.js is wrapped in a module-local CommonJS
object and exported as ESM to avoid a global window.libphonenumber dependency.
No package install scripts or root composer/npm dependency changes were used.
Metadata is bundled locally; parsing performs no network lookup.
Update this pinned metadata deliberately when national numbering plans change.
